Do these providers sell a hosted compute sandbox or hosted compute capacity? For each, add a record with its price, free tier and identity cost, or record why it is not an offer.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- compute/sufy-sandbox $.verdict: No free compute is stated (only 20 GiB local storage, 10 GiB persistent tier, unbilled traffic). Corpus rule: paid-only vs qualifies-with-caveat turns on whether the account gets free usage; this reads paid-only.
- compute/sufy-sandbox $.identity_cost.kind: Neither captured Sufy page says what sign-up asks for; no email or other identity requirement is stated. Needs a sign-up page capture.
- compute/box-by-simular $.verdict: The free credit is one-time (5,000 credits, valid 90 days = 25 h), not recurring; corpus precedent (E2B one-time credit) labels that trial-only. Recurring credits exist only on paid S/M plans.
